notes.title: Update 20250607
notes.content:
Optimise gameplay

In Level 18, you can choose to skip Levels 18-20 and start from Level 21.
Note: This action cannot be undone.

notes.title: update 0605
notes.content:
Improvements:
1. In some level, once the completion conditions are triggered, walking speed will automatically increase.
2. Triggering easy mode will increase walking speed and teleport you to a closer door location.
